source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != background}
    additions = []

    for color in colors:
        points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if len(points) == 2:
            points.sort()
            (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points
            dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
            if dr == 0:
                step = (0, 1 if dc > 0 else -1)
            elif dc == 0:
                step = (1 if dr > 0 else -1, 0)
            elif abs(dr) == abs(dc):
                step = (1 if dr > 0 else -1, 1 if dc > 0 else -1)
            else:
                continue
            # Only extend toward the empty side when the other side is blocked.
            candidates = [(r1-step[0], c1-step[1]), (r2+step[0], c2+step[1])]
            states = []
            for r, c in candidates:
                states.append(None if not (0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0])) else grid[r][c])
            empty = [i for i, v in enumerate(states) if v == background]
            blocked = [i for i, v in enumerate(states) if v is None or (v != background and v != color)]
            if len(empty) == 1 and len(blocked) == 1:
                additions.append((candidates[empty[0]][0], candidates[empty[0]][1], color))
        elif len(points) >= 3:
            # A bent chain carries its direction at the lower endpoint; continue its last step.
            neighbors = {p: [] for p in points}
            for i, p in enumerate(points):
                for q in points[i+1:]:
                    if max(abs(p[0]-q[0]), abs(p[1]-q[1])) == 1:
                        neighbors[p].append(q)
                        neighbors[q].append(p)
            ends = [p for p in points if len(neighbors[p]) == 1]
            if len(ends) == 2:
                end = max(ends)
                prev = neighbors[end][0]
                dr, dc = end[0]-prev[0], end[1]-prev[1]
                rr, cc = end[0]+dr, end[1]+dc
                if 0 <= rr < len(grid) and 0 <= cc < len(grid[0]) and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                    additions.append((rr, cc, color))

    for r, c, color in additions:
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value != background}
    additions = set()

    def cell(r, c):
        if not (0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w):
            return None
        return grid[r][c]

    for color in colors:
        points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(points):
            for r2, c2 in points[i+1:]:
                dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
                if max(abs(dr), abs(dc)) != 1:
                    continue
                before = (r1-dr, c1-dc)
                after = (r2+dr, c2+dc)
                vb, va = cell(*before), cell(*after)
                before_open = vb == background
                after_open = va == background
                before_blocked = vb is None or (vb != background and vb != color)
                after_blocked = va is None or (va != background and va != color)
                if before_open and after_blocked:
                    r, c = before
                    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                        additions.add((r, c, color))
                        r, c = r-dr, c-dc
                elif after_open and before_blocked:
                    r, c = after
                    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background:
                        additions.add((r, c, color))
                        r, c = r+dr, c+dc

    for r, c, color in additions:
        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
